name: Tinctor household

facts.text: The Tinctor household: Botulf (46), Eanfled (45), Ealhhild (44), Cenfus (43) and Cenwahl (43) Tinctor, ghosts, no faction, no spells, respawn 80 s, in the dyers' hamlet (~429.1-429.5k, 392.7-393.1k).
facts.source: world data: Mob/NpcTemplate tables (0.37b runtime database, world tables only)

facts.text: Tinctor is Latin for a dyer; the red dye, the madder and each member's habit are Living Server writing.

story:
The colleges of Avalon let the dales to tenant families who farmed and wove and dyed and kept bees for them, and when the war came the families died in their houses in the first summers and stayed. A drakoran rod holds them there now. The Tinctors dyed red. Tinctor is the readers' Latin for a dyer, and the Dyers never let them forget it.

Botulf Tinctor, the head of the house, took the Latin name from a reader he did work for, and has been defending it ever since.

Eanfled Tinctor gathered the madder for the red and still kneels in the dead field digging for roots.

Ealhhild Tinctor kept the house and the peace inside it, and asks every visitor whether they have come from the Dyers.

Cenfus Tinctor and Cenwahl Tinctor, the brothers, carried the dyed cloth to the Parmenters and fought each other over who carried more, and still stand a step apart, arms full of nothing, arguing.
legend: The Tinctor household: Botulf (46), Eanfled (45), Ealhhild (44), Cenfus (43) and Cenwahl (43) Tinctor, ghosts south-west of the Dyers in the dyers' hamlet. They aggro on sight and stand close together; Cenfus and Cenwahl are nearly on top of each other. Pull from the edge, plain melee, no spells, respawn 80 seconds. The whole house comes back in about a minute and a half, so clear it and move on rather than resting inside.
